english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a difficult situation or an obstacle.
This is the all-purpose choice for difficulty, trouble, or financial hardship.
This is the all-purpose choice for general hardships and difficult circumstances.
Use this specifically for difficulty in carrying out an action or task.
